summary: Stop runtime children when SIGTERM arrives during child startup
details: Include newly started guard, geth and retry-delay processes in container shutdown even when the signal arrives before the supervisor has recorded their PIDs.
Wait for children to exit and ignore repeated stop signals during cleanup, preserving graceful geth shutdown and preventing retry delays from holding the container open.
Exercise the child-registration window for startup checks, live monitoring, geth and retry sleeps in the existing Fast CI runtime tests.
